name: What is Website Entity Optimization for GEO?

mainEntity.name: What is Website Entity Optimization for GEO?

acceptedAnswer.text: Website Entity Optimization for GEO involves structuring your website's content and technical elements to clearly communicate your business, products, services, and locations to search engines. It goes beyond basic SEO by focusing on semantic understanding, helping search engines recognize your business as a distinct entity with specific attributes and a strong local presence. This process improves how your business appears in local search results, map packs, and voice search, making it easier for nearby customers to find you when they search for relevant terms.
acceptedAnswer.description: Website Entity Optimization for GEO structures your site's content and technical elements to clearly communicate your business, services, and locations to search engines, improving local search visibility.
